newsitem.title: USA: Brown Group's Famous Footwear March sales up.
newsitem.headline: Brown Group's Famous Footwear March sales up.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said Thursday that same-store sales at it Famous Footwear unit rose 9.3 percent for the five weeks ended April 5 versus the comparable period last year.

Year to date, Famous Footwear same-store sales were up 7.3 percent. Total sales for the month were $84.9 million, up 13.9 percent versus last year, and year-to-date total sales were $135.8 million, up 12.1 percent.
Brown's Naturalizer retail division same-store sales fell 5.7 percent in March, and total sales were off 6.9 percent, at $12.5 million.
For the first nine weeks of fiscal 1997, Naturalizer same-store sales were off 7.3 percent and total sales fell 8.3 percent to $19.9 million.
The company said a weakness in dress shoe sales and a continuing lack of sufficient promotional product resulted in the March sales decline at Naturalizer.
Brown Group operates Famous Footwear, Naturalizer and F.X. LaSalle chains of footwear retail stores, and markets various brands.
